verdict.rationale: The evidence shows a public API v2 with list and get endpoints for personnel, controls, policies, risks, audits and evidence library items. Those are developer building blocks someone could use to build an extraction, not a documented export or data-portability feature. Nothing in the pack describes exporting all data, exporting in open formats, or supporting offboarding, so the story is not evidenced.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
